generated_note: Typed links for the SWE.4 unit test specification, the SWE.5 software integration plan, the SWE.6 software qualification test plan, the software verification summary and the verification deficiency register authored in this pass. Written into a separate registry file rather than into links-concept-lifecycle.json, so the existing 177 links in that file are unchanged and this file can be diffed against them independently. Every link_id uses the FB2-LNK-VSW- prefix, which no other registry uses, and no endpoint pair in this file appears in any other registry, so the shadowing detector has nothing to report. Every link is review_state pending: none has been examined by a person, and change_suspect_status is false on each because each endpoint revision recorded here is the endpoint's current revision, which is what the corpus derives that field from.

links.rationale: The integration plan's level IL-01 exit criteria require that no module in scope is vacuous, and that each module have a recorded result. That requirement is the output of the unit test specification, so the plan cannot be executed without it. This is a real ordering constraint, not a convenience link.

The qualification plan's level L2 states its strategy as the unit tests with their recorded oracle basis, and pass criteria PC-002, PC-003, PC-004 and PC-005 are all stated against what the unit test specification measured. The plan cannot be assessed without knowing what the unit level actually established.

The qualification plan's level L3 is defined as the integration plan, and its pass criterion PC-007 restates the integration levels' exit criteria. Qualification of integrated software presupposes an integration plan that has been executed, which it has not been.

The summary reports the state the qualification plan describes, including the eleven pass criteria of which six are unmet. If the plan is revised, the summary's verdict is no longer accurate and must be reissued.
The summary's what_is_blocked section reports that 0 of 9 integration steps have been executed. That figure is the integration plan's execution_state, so the summary cannot outlive it.

The summary's what_passed and what_failed sections rest on the same recorded sweep and the same vacuity census the unit test specification reports. The 217 figure and the 5 named vacuous files come from it.
Deficiencies VDR-001, VDR-002, VDR-003 and VDR-005 are the named gaps of the unit test specification. The register tracks them; the specification is where they are derived.

Deficiency VDR-006 is the absent integration test specification and is stated in terms of the integration plan's 5 levels and 9 steps. VDR-009 is a defect of the host environment the plan's IL-01 needs.
Deficiencies VDR-004, VDR-007, VDR-008 and VDR-010 are stated against the qualification plan's levels L1 to L5 and its pass criteria PC-006, PC-008, PC-009, PC-010 and PC-011.

The register's residual_risk_statement is written against the summary's verdict. The summary says verification is incomplete; the register says what is being carried by leaving it that way. They cannot disagree, so the register tracks the summary.

SWE.4 is verification against detailed design. The specification states what of the LTC 6813-1 AFE driver detailed design is covered by the 11 behaviour cases and the 39 PEC drift assertions, and what is not. Note the coverage is partial: 5 of the driver's public entry points carry assertions.

The specification records that the SOA detailed design is verified by nothing. test_soa.c asserts three NULL-pointer traps and its routine output-verification step is the literal text TODO, so the design's behaviour model, its nine limit providers and its failure response are all uncovered. A link that records non-coverage is still the correct traceability edge, and this is the corpus's clearest example of one.

The specification records that the contactor detailed design is verified by nothing executed. test_contactor.c is a build failure in the recorded run, so none of its 7 cases has a result, and its 2 assertions are argument-validation only against a design that decomposes into three internal units.

The requirement's three acceptance criteria are 50 ms acquisition period, 100% PEC rejection before database write and 25 ms database publish latency. The plan's pass criterion PC-008 states that all three must be demonstrated against a recorded result, and the specification records that the PEC criterion is covered only on a self-consistency oracle and that neither latency criterion has any oracle at all.

The requirement's four acceptance criteria are 5 ms classification latency, 1 mV threshold accuracy, 1E-6 events/hour false positives under 5 mV Gaussian noise and 2 ms fault-request latency. The plan's PC-009 states that the debounce criterion cannot be met because the detailed design records no debounce in the source, and the specification records that the SOA module's routine outcome is unasserted. This is the weakest requirement-to-verification link in the corpus.

The requirement's three acceptance criteria are 5 ms fault-response latency, 100% auxiliary feedback readback and 100% valid state transitions. The specification records that the contactor driver's only test does not build, so none of the three has any result, and the plan's PC-008 requires a measured clock for the latency criterion.

The integration plan's execution_state names this record as the planning stub that stands in for the absent SW Integration Test Specification, and its unblock_conditions state that a plan does not substitute for a specification. The dependency is recorded so the gap is visible from the plan itself rather than only from the coverage disposition.

The qualification plan's level L4 and its results_records_absent section both name this record as the blocked qualification execution, execution_kind none with outcome blocked. The plan cannot claim any qualification coverage until this record carries a result, and the record cannot carry a result until the SW Qualification Test Specification the plan says is absent exists.
